translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, Guan Qi, prefect of Shao, requested that at Rongling Town in Huizhou and Cheng a strategic site be chosen to build a walled stockade and end border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: In 1080, Shao Prefect Guan Qi asked to build a fortified stockade at a strategic point in Rongling Town of Huizhou and Cheng to end border troubles.

sentences.zh: 詔湖南安撫謝景溫、轉運使朱初平、判官趙揚商度以聞，景溫等以為宜如杞言。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hunan Pacification Commissioner Xie Jingwen, Transport Commissioner Zhu Chuping, and Judge Zhao Yang to deliberate and report; Jingwen and the others held that Guan Qi's proposal should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court told Hunan Pacification Commissioner Xie Jingwen, Transport Commissioner Zhu Chuping, and Judge Zhao Yang to study the plan. They agreed with Guan Qi.

sentences.zh: 乃議誠州以沅州貫保砦為渠陽縣隸之，以徽州為蒔竹縣隸邵州。

translations.literal: It was then proposed that Cheng Prefecture take Yuan's Guanbao Stockade as Qiyang County under its jurisdiction, and that Huizhou become Zhizhu County under Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed making Yuan's Guanbao Stockade into Qiyang County under Cheng, and Huizhou into Zhizhu County under Shao.

sentences.zh: 趙揚言上江、多星、銅鼓、羊鎮、潭溪、上和、上誠、天村、大田等團並至誠州城下貿易，可漸招撫，並乞下湖南邵州蒔竹縣招諭芙蓉、萬驛諸團，從之，徒誠州治渠陽而貫保為砦如故。

translations.literal: Zhao Yang said that the regiments Shangjiang, Duoxing, Tonggu, Yangzhen, Tanxi, Shanghe, Shangcheng, Tiancun, Datian, and others all came to trade below Cheng Prefecture city and could gradually be won over; he also asked that Furong, Wanyi, and other regiments be summoned through Zhizhu County in Shao, Hunan — approved; Cheng Prefecture's seat was moved to Qiyang while Guanbao remained a stockade as before.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yang reported that regiments such as Shangjiang, Duoxing, and Datian already traded at Cheng and could be won over gradually, and asked Shao's Zhizhu County to summon the Furong and Wanyi regiments. The court agreed, moved Cheng's seat to Qiyang, and left Guanbao a stockade.

sentences.zh: 上江等諸團果皆納土，於是增築多星等砦，還連徽、廣西融州王口砦焉。

translations.literal: The Shangjiang regiments and others did indeed submit their lands; additional stockades such as Duoxing were then built, reconnecting with Huizhou and Wangkou Stockade in Guangxi's Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangjiang regiments submitted, new stockades including Duoxing were built, and the line was linked again to Huizhou and Wangkou Stockade in Guangxi's Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，改誠州為渠陽軍，罷兩州兵馬及守禦民丁。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanyou, Cheng Prefecture was changed to Qiyang Army, and the troops and defensive militia of both prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1087, Cheng was downgraded to Qiyang Army and the garrisons and militia of both prefectures were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 有楊晟台者，乘間寇文村堡，知渠陽軍胡田措置亡術，蠻結西融州蠻砦粟仁催，往來兩路為民患，調兵屯渠陽至萬人，湖南亦增屯兵應援，三路俱驚。

translations.literal: Yang Shengtai seized the opportunity to raid Wencun Fort; Hu Tian, commander of Qiyang Army, handled matters ineptly; tribes allied with Surencui of the Man stockade in western Rong and ranged both circuits plaguing the people; troops stationed at Qiyang reached ten thousand, Hunan also increased garrisons in support, and all three circuits were alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shengtai raided Wencun Fort. Qiyang commander Hu Tian mishandled the crisis as tribes allied with Surencui of western Rong and harassed both circuits. Ten thousand troops massed at Qiyang, Hunan sent reinforcements, and all three circuits were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 朝廷方務省事，議廢堡砦，徹戍守，而以其地予蠻，乃詔湖北轉運副使李茂直招撫，又遣唐乂同措置邊事討之。

translations.literal: The court was then pursuing simplicity and discussed abolishing forts and stockades, withdrawing garrisons, and granting the land to the tribes; Hubei deputy transport commissioner Li Maozhi was ordered to win them over, and Tang Yi was also sent to manage border affairs and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking to simplify administration, the court considered abandoning forts, withdrawing garrisons, and ceding land to the tribes. Li Maozhi of Hubei was told to pacify them, and Tang Yi was sent to handle the border campaign.

sentences.zh: 後以渠陽為誠州，命光僭之子供備庫使昌達、供備庫副使楊昌等同知州事，而貫保、豐山、若水等砦皆罷戍，擇授土官，俾乂間毀樓櫓，撤官舍，護領居民入砦。

translations.literal: Later Qiyang was restored as Cheng Prefecture; Guangjian's sons Changda, Supply Depot Commissioner, and Yang Chang, Deputy Supply Commissioner, were made co-administrators; Guanbao, Fengshan, Ruoshui, and other stockades all ended garrison duty, native officials were chosen and appointed, and Yi was to destroy towers, remove government buildings, and escort residents into the stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Qiyang was later restored as Cheng. Guangjian's sons Changda and Yang Chang were made co-administrators. Garrisons at Guanbao, Fengshan, Ruoshui, and elsewhere were withdrawn, native officials appointed, and Yi ordered to dismantle towers, remove offices, and move residents into the stockades.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，改誠州為靖州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning, Cheng Prefecture was renamed Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongning, Cheng was renamed Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南丹州

translations.literal: Nandan Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Nandan Prefecture

sentences.zh: 南丹州蠻，亦溪峒之別種也，地與宜州及西南夷接壤。

translations.literal: The Man of Nandan Prefecture were also a separate branch of the stream-caves; their territory bordered Yi Prefecture and the southwestern Yi peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Nandan tribes were another stream-cave people, bordering Yi Prefecture and the southwestern tribal realms.

sentences.zh: 開寶七年，酋帥莫洪[B16D]遣使陳紹規奉表求內附。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kaibao, the chieftain Mo Honghe sent the envoy Chen Shaogui with a memorial seeking submission to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In 974, chieftain Mo Honghe sent Chen Shaogui with a memorial seeking to join the empire.

sentences.zh: 九年，復來貢，求賜牌印，詔刻印以給之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they again offered tribute and requested plaques and seals; an edict ordered seals carved and granted.
translations.idiomatic: In 976 they paid tribute again and asked for official plaques and seals, which the court provided.

sentences.zh: 太平興國五年，洪[B16D]貢銀百兩，以賀太平。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo, Honghe offered one hundred taels of silver to celebrate the era of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: In 980, Honghe sent one hundred taels of silver to celebrate the era of great peace.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，洪[B16D]族人知寶隆鎮莫淮閬牛一頭，逐水草至金城州河池縣，宜州牙校周承鑒以其牛耕作，淮閬三遣人取牛，承鑒不還，凡耕十日，始釋牛逐水草去。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, Mo Huailang of Honghe's clan, magistrate of Baolong Town, had an ox that followed pasture to Hechi County in Jincheng Prefecture; Zhou Chengjian, military adjutant of Yi Prefecture, used the ox to plow; Huailang sent men three times to reclaim it, but Chengjian would not return it and plowed for ten days before releasing the ox to follow pasture away.
translations.idiomatic: In 987, Mo Huailang of Honghe's clan pastured an ox into Hechi County in Jincheng. Yi adjutant Zhou Chengjian seized it for plowing. Huailang sent men three times to reclaim it, but Chengjian kept the ox for ten days before releasing it.

sentences.zh: 淮閬怒，領鄉兵六十人劫取承鑒家資財，驅縣民莫世家牛六頭以歸，誘群蠻為寇。

translations.literal: Huailang was enraged, led sixty local troops to plunder Chengjian's household goods, drove six oxen belonging to the Mo clan of the county back with him, and incited the tribes to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Huailang led sixty local troops to loot Chengjian's home, drove off six oxen belonging to the Mo clan, and incited tribal raids.

sentences.zh: 上遣供奉官王承緒乘傳劾承鑒，具伏占牛，詔棄市。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Palace Attendant Wang Chengxu by express relay to investigate Chengjian; he fully confessed to seizing the ox, and an edict ordered execution in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Wang Chengxu was sent to investigate. Chengjian confessed to seizing the ox and was executed.

sentences.zh: 時知宜州、讚善大夫侯汀失於備禦，群蠻之擾，頗害及民庶，詔發諸州兵進討，兵未至，悉已遁歸，汀坐免官。

translations.literal: At that time Hou Ting, Adviser to the Heir Apparent and prefect of Yi, had failed in defense; the tribal disturbances harmed the common people considerably; an edict mobilized troops from various prefectures, but before they arrived all had fled home, and Ting was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefect Hou Ting had failed to defend the border and the raids harmed civilians. Imperial troops were mobilized, but the tribes fled before they arrived. Ting was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔諭宜、融、柳州百姓及蠻界人戶曰：“朕托兆庶之上，處司牧之重，照臨所暨，撫養是均，矧於遐陬，尤所軫慮。

translations.literal: An edict addressed the people of Yi, Rong, and Liu prefectures and households on the tribal frontier: "I stand above the myriad people, bearing the weight of governance; wherever my gaze reaches, nurture is equal — and for distant corners I am especially concerned."
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the people of Yi, Rong, and Liu and the tribal frontier said: "I stand above the myriad people bearing the weight of rule. Wherever my gaze reaches, I nurture equally — and distant corners concern me most."

sentences.zh: 昨以知宜州事侯汀失於綏緝，恣其侵牟，致茲邊夷，起為寇鈔，侵騷閭裏，虔劉士庶。

translations.literal: Recently, because Hou Ting in charge of Yi failed in pacification and allowed oppression, these border tribes rose to raid and plunder, disturbing villages and slaughtering subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hou Ting failed to govern Yi and allowed oppression, border tribes rose to raid villages and kill subjects.

sentences.zh: 及興師而討伐，乃畏威而竄伏。

translations.literal: When troops were raised to punish them, they feared authority and hid away.
translations.idiomatic: When troops marched against them, they hid in fear of imperial might.

sentences.zh: 朕以興戎召釁，職由於汀，爰舉國章，削其官秩。

translations.literal: I hold that war was provoked through Ting's fault, and therefore applied the national statutes and stripped him of rank.
translations.idiomatic: War was provoked through Ting's fault, and I stripped him of rank by law.

sentences.zh: 汝等所宜體予含垢，革乃前非，安土厚生，保境延世，嬉我至化，是為永圖。

translations.literal: You should embody my forbearance, reform your former errors, settle the land and enrich life, guard your borders and extend your generations, and rejoice in my supreme transformation — this is the lasting plan.
translations.idiomatic: Embody my forbearance, reform your ways, settle your lands, guard your borders, and rejoice in imperial grace — that is the lasting plan.

sentences.zh: 或尚恣於陸梁，當盡剿其族類。

translations.literal: If any still indulge in violence, their entire clans shall be exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: If any still resort to violence, their clans shall be exterminated.

sentences.zh: ”自是不復為寇。

translations.literal: " From then on they raided no more.
translations.idiomatic: They raided no more.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年，洪[B16D]卒，其弟洪皓襲稱刺史，遣其子淮通來貢銀碗二十，銅鼓三面，銅印一鈕，旗一帖，繡真珠紅羅襦一。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunhua, Honghe died; his brother Honghao succeeded as self-styled prefect and sent his son Huaitong with twenty silver bowls, three bronze drums, one bronze seal knob, one banner, and one embroidered pearl-red silk jacket as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In 990, Honghe died and his brother Honghao succeeded, sending his son Huaitong with silver bowls, bronze drums, a seal, a banner, and an embroidered silk jacket as tribute.

sentences.zh: 上降優詔，賜彩百匹，還其襦。

translations.literal: The emperor issued a gracious edict, granted one hundred bolts of colored silk, and returned the jacket.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a gracious edict, granted one hundred bolts of silk, and returned the jacket.

sentences.zh: 自洪[B16D]領州十餘年，歲輸白金百兩。

translations.literal: From the time Honghe ruled the prefecture for more than ten years, he paid one hundred taels of white silver yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Honghe had ruled for more than ten years, paying one hundred taels of silver annually.

sentences.zh: 洪皓之襲兄位，專其地利，不修常貢。

translations.literal: When Honghao succeeded his brother, he monopolized the region's profits and ceased regular tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Honghao monopolized the region's profits and stopped paying regular tribute.

sentences.zh: 其弟洪沅忿之，挈妻子來奔宜州。

translations.literal: His brother Hongyuan resented this and fled with wife and children to Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Hongyuan fled with his family to Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪皓怒其背己，數引兵攻洪沅。

translations.literal: Honghao was angry at this betrayal and repeatedly led troops against Hongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Honghao attacked Hongyuan repeatedly in anger.

sentences.zh: 洪沅與二男並牙將一人，乘傳詣闕訴其事，請發兵致討。

translations.literal: Hongyuan, with two sons and one military adjutant, traveled by express relay to court to plead the case and request troops for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyuan traveled to court with two sons and an adjutant to plead for troops against his brother.

sentences.zh: 上以蠻夷之俗，羈縻而已，不欲為之興師報怨。

translations.literal: The emperor held that tribal custom required only loose rein and did not wish to raise armies for private vengeance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that tribes required only loose rein and would not wage war for private vengeance.

sentences.zh: 洪沅先自稱南丹州副使，以為邵州團練使，給田十頃，下詔戒敕洪皓。

translations.literal: Hongyuan had styled himself Vice Commissioner of Nandan; he was made Regimentation Commissioner of Shao, granted ten qing of land, and an edict admonished Honghao.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyuan was made Regimentation Commissioner of Shao with ten qing of land, and Honghao was admonished by edict.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，洪皓死，長子淮襲父任。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, Honghao died and his eldest son Huai succeeded to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In 1005, Honghao died and his eldest son Huai succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 俄為弟淮辿攻南丹州，淮帥屬來奔，詔宜州賜閑田資給之。

translations.literal: Soon his brother Huaiyi attacked Nandan; Huai led his followers in flight, and an edict ordered Yi Prefecture to grant idle land and support.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his brother Huaiyi attacked Nandan. Huai fled with his followers, and Yi Prefecture was ordered to grant them land and support.

sentences.zh: 大中詳符五年，宜州言淮辿頗集諸蠻，阻富仁監道路，上廉知淮辿無侵擾狀，遣使犒設撫勞之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Yi reported that Huaiyi had gathered many tribes and blocked the road to Furen Stockade; the emperor, knowing Huaiyi had not raided, sent envoys with rewards to console him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1012, Yi reported that Huaiyi had gathered tribes and blocked the road to Furen Stockade. Learning he had not raided, the emperor sent envoys with rewards.

sentences.zh: 九年，撫水蠻叛，詔淮辿約勒溪峒，勿從誘脅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Fushui tribes rebelled; Huaiyi was ordered to restrain the stream-caves and not follow seduction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1016, when the Fushui tribes rebelled, Huaiyi was told to restrain the stream-caves from joining them.

sentences.zh: 明年，平撫水蠻，淮辿等並以勞進秩。

translations.literal: The next year, when the Fushui tribes were pacified, Huaiyi and others were all promoted for their merit.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, after the Fushui tribes were pacified, Huaiyi and others were promoted for their service.

sentences.zh: 景祐三年，有淮戟者舉族來歸，命為湖南州團練副使，敕州縣拊存。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingyou, Huaiji brought his entire clan to submit and was appointed Deputy Regimentation Commissioner of Hunan; prefectures and counties were ordered to comfort and sustain them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1036, Huaiji brought his clan to submit and was made Deputy Regimentation Commissioner of Hunan, with orders to local officials to care for them.

sentences.zh: 後淮辿老，自言願傳其子世漸。

translations.literal: Later, when Huaiyi grew old, he said he wished to pass office to his son Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: When Huaiyi grew old, he asked to pass office to his son Shijian.

sentences.zh: 至和元年，命世漸為檢校散騎常侍，權發遣州事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, Shijian was appointed acting Regular Attendant and provisional administrator of prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1054, Shijian was made acting Regular Attendant and provisional administrator of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年，以淮辿為懷遠大將軍致仕，世漸為刺史、檢校工部尚書，賜袍帶，錢十萬，絹百匹。

translations.literal: The next year Huaiyi was made retired General of Cherishing the Distant, and Shijian became prefect and acting Minister of Works, granted robe and belt, one hundred thousand cash, and one hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Huaiyi retired as General of Cherishing the Distant, and Shijian became prefect and acting Minister of Works with robe, belt, one hundred thousand cash, and one hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 又補其親黨數十人為檢校官，如故事也。

translations.literal: Several dozen of his kinsmen were also given acting offices, according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen kinsmen received acting offices as before.

sentences.zh: 世漸死，嘉祐末，命其子公帳襲之。

translations.literal: When Shijian died, at the end of Jiayou his son Gongzhang was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shijian died late in Jiayou, his son Gongzhang succeeded.

sentences.zh: 有世忍者，亦淮辿之子也。

translations.literal: There was also Shiren, another son of Huaiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Shiren was another son of Huaiyi.

sentences.zh: 初率其屬人內附，治平初逃歸，攻殺公帳，奪其地自首，請於朝廷，願授刺史，補其親黨如故事，歲輸銀百兩。

translations.literal: He had first led his followers to submit; at the beginning of Zhiping he fled back, killed Gongzhang, seized the land, and surrendered himself, asking the court to appoint him prefect, grant his kinsmen offices as before, and pay one hundred taels of silver yearly.
translations.idiomatic: He had once submitted with his followers, but early in Zhiping fled back, killed Gongzhang, seized the land, and petitioned the court for the prefecture, offices for his kinsmen, and an annual tribute of one hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 三年，遂命為刺史，皆如其請。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed prefect, all as he had requested.
translations.idiomatic: In 1066 he was appointed prefect with everything he had asked for.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，徭賊殺人，世忍執以獻，授檢校禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, when Yao bandits killed people, Shiren seized and presented them and was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In 1069, when Yao bandits killed people, Shiren captured and handed them over and was made acting Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年入貢，其印以“西南諸道武盛軍德政官家明天國主”為文，詔以南丹州印賜之，令毀其舊印。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng he offered tribute; his seal bore the text "Lord of the Bright Heaven Kingdom, Virtuous Ruler of the Martial Prosperity Army of the Southwestern Circuits"; an edict granted the Nandan seal and ordered the old one destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1080 he paid tribute with a seal bearing grandiose titles. The court granted the Nandan seal and ordered the old one destroyed.

sentences.zh: 六年，大軍討安化，世忍獻弓矢，自言願世世為外臣，修貢不懈，遷檢校戶部尚書，給銅牌旗號，官其子侄九人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when a great army campaigned against Anhua, Shiren presented bows and arrows, declared he wished to be an outer subject for generations with unceasing tribute, was promoted to acting Minister of Revenue, granted bronze plaques and banners, and nine sons and nephews were given office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1083, during the campaign against Anhua, Shiren sent bows and arrows, pledged eternal vassalage and steady tribute, was promoted to acting Minister of Revenue, given bronze plaques and banners, and nine kinsmen received office.

sentences.zh: 世忍死，子公佞襲。

translations.literal: When Shiren died, his son Gongning succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Shiren died, his son Gongning succeeded.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，廣西經略使王祖道言公佞就擒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan, Guangxi frontier commissioner Wang Zudao reported that Gongning had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: In 1107, Guangxi commissioner Wang Zudao reported that Gongning had been captured.

sentences.zh: 進築平、允、從州，牧文、地、蘭、那、安、外、習、南丹八州之地，並為鎮庭孚觀州、延德軍，以其弟公晟襲刺史。

translations.literal: Advancing, he built Ping, Yun, and Cong prefectures and took the lands of Wen, Di, Lan, Na, An, Wai, Xi, and Nandan — eight prefectures — establishing Zhenning Fu Guan Prefecture and Yande Army, with Gongning's brother Gongsheng succeeding as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced, built Ping, Yun, and Cong prefectures, seized eight tribal prefectures including Nandan, established Guan Prefecture and Yande Army, and installed Gongning's brother Gongsheng as prefect.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，公晟乞以州事付其侄延豐，願與其子歸朝，詔從之，仍乘驛給券。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuanhe, Gongsheng asked to entrust prefectural affairs to his nephew Yanfeng and wished to come to court with his son; an edict approved and granted relay horses and passes.
translations.idiomatic: In 1122, Gongsheng asked to entrust the prefecture to his nephew Yanfeng and come to court with his son. The court agreed and provided relay transport.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，公晟攻圍觀州，焚寶積監。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, Gongsheng besieged Guan Prefecture and burned Baoji Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133, Gongsheng besieged Guan Prefecture and burned Baoji Stockade.

sentences.zh: 朱勝非奏：“崇、觀、宣和間所開新邊，比來往往棄而不守，帥臣、監司屢言觀州為控扼之地。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei memorialized: "The new frontiers opened in the Chongning, Guan, and Xuanhe eras have often been abandoned; commanders and supervisors repeatedly say Guan Prefecture is a point of strategic control."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei wrote that new frontiers opened under Chongning, Guan, and Xuanhe had often been abandoned, though officials repeatedly called Guan Prefecture strategically vital.

sentences.zh: 不宜棄。

translations.literal: It should not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: It should not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“前日用事之臣，貪功生事，公為欺罔，其實勞民費財，使遠俗不安也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The officials in power before were greedy for merit and provoked trouble with public deceit; in truth they exhausted the people and wasted funds and made distant peoples uneasy."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that earlier officials had provoked trouble for glory, exhausting the people, wasting funds, and unsettling distant tribes.

sentences.zh: ”又用廣南經略安撫使劉彥適言，以公晟知南丹州兼溪峒都巡檢使、提舉盜賊公事，給以南丹州刺史舊印，公晟未受命。

translations.literal: " Following Guangnan Pacification Commissioner Liu Yanshi, Gongsheng was made Administrator of Nandan with concurrent overall stream-cave inspector and commissioner for bandit affairs, and given the old Nandan prefect seal; Gongsheng did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Following Liu Yanshi of Guangnan, Gongsheng was offered Nandan with concurrent stream-cave inspection and bandit-suppression duties and the old prefect seal, but he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，公晟始貢馬，率諸蠻來歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Gongsheng first offered horses and led the various tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1154, Gongsheng first offered horses and led the tribes back to submission.

sentences.zh: 帝諭輔臣曰：“得南丹非為廣地也，但徭人不叛，百姓安業，為可喜耳。

translations.literal: The emperor told his ministers: "Gaining Nandan is not for expanding territory; it is only that the Yao do not rebel and the people live in peace — that is what is gratifying."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his ministers that Nandan was not about expanding territory but about keeping the Yao peaceful and the people secure — that was what mattered.

sentences.zh: ”遂以延沈襲公晟職，授銀青光祿大夫、檢校太子賓客、使持節南丹州諸軍事、南丹州刺史兼御史大夫、知南丹州公事、武騎尉。

translations.literal: " Yan Shen was then made to succeed Gongsheng, appointed Silver-Gleaming Grand Master, acting Guest of the Heir Apparent, commissioner with staff for all military affairs of Nandan, Prefect of Nandan with concurrent Grand Censor, Administrator of Nandan, and Martial Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shen succeeded Gongsheng as Silver-Gleaming Grand Master, acting Guest of the Heir Apparent, military commissioner of Nandan, prefect with concurrent censorial rank, and Martial Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 廣西經略安撫使呂願中諭降諸蠻三十二種，得州二十七，縣一百三十五，砦四十，峒一百七十九及一鎮、三十二團，皆為羈縻州縣。

translations.literal: Guangxi Pacification Commissioner Lu Yuanzhong announced the submission of thirty-two tribal peoples, yielding twenty-seven prefectures, 135 counties, 40 stockades, 179 caves, one town, and thirty-two regiments — all made loosely governed prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yuanzhong of Guangxi reported thirty-two tribal groups submitting, yielding twenty-seven prefectures, 135 counties, 40 stockades, 179 caves, one town, and thirty-two regiments — all organized as loosely governed districts.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，延沈進補團練、防禦二使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Yan Shen was further promoted to Regimentation and Defense Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1155, Yan Shen was further promoted to Regimentation and Defense Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，延沈恣行慘酷，為諸蠻所逐，歸死省地，眾推延廩襲職。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Yan Shen indulged in cruelty and was driven out by the tribes; he returned to provincial territory and died there, and the multitude installed Yanlin to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1161, Yan Shen's cruelty drove the tribes to expel him. He died in provincial territory, and Yanlin succeeded.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年，延廩復為諸蠻所圖，攜家歸朝，經略司奏以延葚襲職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing, Yanlin was again plotted against by the tribes, brought his family to court, and the frontier commission memorialized that Yanqin should succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1164, Yanlin was plotted against again, brought his family to court, and the frontier commission recommended Yanqin to succeed.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，南丹為永樂州所攻，使來告急，廣西帥臣遣將領陳泰權、天河縣主簿徐彌高諭和之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, Nandan was attacked by Yongle Prefecture; envoys came in urgent appeal, and the Guangxi commander sent Chen Taiquan and Xu Migao, recorder of Tianhe County, to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: In 1174, Yongle attacked Nandan. The Guangxi commander sent Chen Taiquan and Tianhe recorder Xu Migao to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 十四年，經略司奏以延陰襲職，詔從其請。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the frontier commission memorialized that Yanyin should succeed, and an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: In 1187, the frontier commission recommended Yanyin to succeed, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 嘉定五年，延陰之子光熙襲職，知南丹州事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiading, Yanyin's son Guang Xi succeeded and administered Nandan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1212, Yanyin's son Guang Xi succeeded as Administrator of Nandan.
